paragraphs: International gold is at $4,122 an ounce, the rupee at ₹95.05 to the dollar, and the Indian jeweller board median at ₹14,809/g for 24K.
What the world's gold news is about today: US interest rates (11 headlines), The US dollar (7 headlines), Inflation (2 headlines), Geopolitics and safe-haven buying (2 headlines).

US interest rates. Gold pays no interest, so expectations of lower US rates tend to support it and higher rates tend to weigh on it. In the news: Gold Slips as Treasury Yields Hold Firm, Fed Path Keeps Bullion Boxed In (BigGo Finance); Gold price reverses gains as investors weigh Fed rate path (Mining.com.au).

The US dollar. Gold is priced in dollars: a stronger dollar usually pushes it down, a weaker one lifts it. In the news: October 20 Financial Morning Brief: Gold prices pressured by stronger dollar; markets await policy guidance. Russian diesel has not yet entered the market, while oil prices hit a one-month high. (富途牛牛); Gold edges lower as firm dollar, elevated yields weigh (Reuters).

Inflation. Gold is held as an inflation hedge, though hot inflation can also mean higher rates, which cuts the other way. In the news: Precious Metals StoneX Bullion weekly round-up 101926; US Inflation higher-for-longer? (StoneX); Gold Prices Fall Below $4,100, US Inflation Boosts Rate Hike Bets (VOI.ID).
